column3: Kuroneko Route · Kuroneko's Assistant
Finally, I'll be starting work as Kuroneko's assistant from today onwards!
Well, it's good that I prepared myself before I arrived, however...
The meeting point should be somewhere around here, I guess?
Hmm...
I'm sure it's somewhere I've been to many times before...
Hmm? Could it be that we're going to start doing work there?
Or are we going somewhere else once we meet up?
No, it doesn't seem right... We should be going to somewhere... how should I put it...
Right, right. It should be somewhere we can work at.
Where could that be...
It's still summer vacation, so I think any place should be fine...
I guess I'll wait here.
Kuroneko will surely come.
Kuroneko hasn't arrived yet...
I came in high spirits, but... when the other party isn't here it makes me kind of uneasy.
But still, it's a bit early from the appointed time.
If I wait here, it should be fine...
Well, that's why I came but...
Kuroneko still hasn't arrived yet...
Well, if I wait a little she'll come for sure...
She's not coming at all...
I feel... restless all of a sudden...
Is this really the meeting spot?
Somehow, I have a bad feeling...
Could it be that I was mistaken?
If I were to take a look at other places, time-wise it would be my last chance to go now...
Gah, this is bothersome.
I'm waiting here! I'm sure it's here! It's probably Kuroneko who's late!
---was what I thought, but...
She still hasn't come.
Eh? So I really made a mistake?
It's from Kuroneko...
How much longer will you make me wait? You're just a manservant and you have that kind of nerve?
...I'm waiting at the classroom.
...I'm sorry.
So she's already here? ...Damn, so I'm late...
Oh my, you're surprisingly fast.
That's my line. I actually thought of coming earlier.
I'm the one who invited you here, remember? It's a given that I'll be here earlier.
Damn, I thought of being earlier than you, then wait for you a little...
Oh, your intention is admirable.
I decided to spend my summer vacation for your sake. That's why I wanted to show you my determination.
...Is that so.
Well then... then don't slow me down and try your very best.
Yeah, leave it to me.
Well then, allow me to explain to you which areas you need to take note...
Yeah... Wait, about that.
What's wrong?
Isn't it a little warm here? Are you all right?
I'm fine. I'm already used to this heat.
But, didn't you collapse not too long ago? What if that happened again...
That's just lack of sleep, I'm fine now... Still, you won't be relieved even if I said that, right?
Yeah, of course.
But there isn't anywhere else suitable. Do you know of other good places besides here?
...What about my house?
But with your sister over there?
Ah...
The two of you would certainly quarrel. What about other places...
Nowhere, right? A place where we can speak freely and spend no money at is extremely valuable.
Even so... What if her physical condition turns for the worse...
The classroom has an air-conditioning system, but we can't turn it on as we please...
Aren't there any other cooler places...?
There's still one possible place... though.
I'm listening.
How about your house?
And here I was wondering about what you were going to suggest so suddenly... it can't be done.
Why? Is there a problem?
I'm sure there's a problem. Why must you absolutely come to my house?
Because I won't let you work in this hot classroom.
Besides that?
This reason is enough, right? Besides your health, what other reason should there be?
G-Good grief... Can't you speak with a little more reservation?
I'm not too good with that.
Do you have any ulterior motives for wanting to go to my house?
Ulterior motives?
T-That being...
I've said it many times. I'm only worried about your health.
How about I try collapsing in front of you. It really scared me that time...
...Senpai.
That's why, we'll work at your house.
...Fine.
I also want to take a look at your room.
...And you've just ruined it.
